items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p20 left with the 20 uL rack in slot 10, p300 right with the 300 uL rack in slot 11.
Log shows 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate B1 with the p300; no other wells touched.
The log shows pick up tip before the first aspirate and drop tip at the end; one tip was reused.
100 uL is within p300 limits, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the simulation passed.
Single transfer step is fully implemented with no extra steps and no inaccurate comments; metadata is fine.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified labware and pipettes, and the simulator log shows the p300 moving 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and again to plate B1. It uses one tip, drops it at the end, and has no other issues.
